name: Draw Obby [NEW]
desc:
👍Please thumbs up to support the game!

🧠Use your big brain to complete these hard and easy obby puzzles!

🎨Use spray paint to draw lines, wheels, zig zags, or anything else you want!  You are free to draw anything to pass the levels! You can speed past the obstacles or you can get creative and draw intricate things like an artist!


Total levels: 30+
You can recommend level designs! We're going to update and add lots of levels.

🌟RELEASE🌟
-30 stages!
-3 different drawing shapes!
-Pressure plates!
-Trampolines
-Acid blocks
